card.name: Institution name ending before a city
card.fires_on: The last word of an institution's name (Laboratory, Hospital, Center, System, conference) when a place such as a city or region is about to follow. Seen in news and web text about researchers and where they work.

modes.label: Lab or hospital name
modes.description: Final word of a research lab, hospital or medical center name, just before 'in' and a city.
modes.example: Huron Valley Sinai<< Hospital>> in Commerce Township

modes.label: Other institution or event
modes.description: Final word of a center, control room, campus or conference name, followed by a location.
modes.example: Europe's mission<< control>> in Toulouse, France

card.writes: It promotes 'in' and 'near' (and their equivalents in other languages), so a location is likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires at the end of an institution's name, when the text is about to say what city or place it is in.
